- Root: grace-cure card payment (customer's own write).
- Hop 1 (state-derived): grace_cure_card_payment states the payment "is fixed only after the account's ledger carries a vision-line termination credit posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last, whenever a vision plan unit the account funds ended by voluntary termination before that month". Records: subscriber vision enrollment terminated 2026-06-30, reason voluntary; invoice issued last coverage 2026-10; the only vision-line termination credit is posted against 2026-07 → state unmet. Search with the sentence's words "vision-line termination credit" → vision_termination_credit_entry: "recorded on the account's billing ledger as a premium credit on the vision product line, marked as a termination credit — a vision-line termination credit — … posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last … It is booked on the account by the agent." That is the write that brings the state about.
- No further hop: the vision credit docs carry no waits-on sentence.
- Order: vision credit (agent) → grace-cure payment (user). No hop is pre-solved: the grace doc names only its own tool; no route or chain is stated.

Mateo's cancelled rider is not active → 3 plan units, not 4. The 60.00 EFT return is not an "automatic draft" (paid 0 months) — the 09-11 return decides Case B either way.
- Closest alternative time anchors: hold measured from receipt date; standing-relief window "+1" applied to the month window (per its own worked example "so the grace count runs over 3 months").
- Open on the visible side: the claims scope of the early-cancellation offset (subscriber enrollment vs whole family plan unit) — two readings 74.56/267.62 vs 154.32/187.86. Recorded as a candidate KB-RUNTIME issue pending the reveal.
- Conditional: P = 36.28 rests on the Vision Plans premium schedule, not yet published; ortho rider premium 12.40 likewise (not used in the numbers).

**KB-RUNTIME RED (R0-1): offset claims population ambiguous on the visible surface.**
- Symptom: the blind audit found two equally reasonable populations for "vision benefits paid" in the early-cancellation offset: the subscriber enrollment's own claims (45.00, no offset → credit 154.32, grace-cure 187.86) or every vision claim of the household (370.00, offset 79.76 → 74.56 / 267.62). The blind answer reached GT only by an economic inference (the compared premium is the family-tier premium) and the persona's mention of the family's receipts — neither is a visible policy sentence.
- Root cause: docs/billing/vision_early_cancellation_benefit_offset_3eeae95a.json, Rule sentence: "…when the unit ended before its second coverage anniversary and the Vision Plans benefits paid on it outran the premium." Combined with vision_termination_credit_calculation_a2347af9.json "The vision plan unit is the subscriber's Vision Plans enrollment …" and per-enrollment claim records (vision_claims.vision_plan_id), "paid on it" reads as the subscriber's enrollment only. The source rule has no such scope ("the vision benefits paid are the plan payments on vision services remarked as paid …", "the vision benefits paid on services within the unit's coverage window exceed …") and the compute (ben_unit) sums every vision claim of the customer (XSUM, customer-scoped) within the window.
- Evidence: find_vision_claims returns 10 rows across four enrollments (e7c24dcd 45.00; 7e745941 45+30+65; 7d6257fd 45+30+65; 9022966c 45+45 with a 45.00 reversal); GT factor_trace "out-of-network reimbursements 370.00 net of the reversal; tier 1 -> offset 79.76; baseline gives 154.32".
- Affected: vision_early_cancellation_benefit_offset_3eeae95a.json, opening Rule sentence. (Same defect is recorded as KB-BIJECTION RED in policy_kb/…/0.md.) Policy-side note: the source rule itself never names whose vision services count (see policy_kb SRC-1).

Other items: no hop pre-solved; no gold value appears in any doc example or tool schema (grep of 74.56, 154.32, 267.62, 187.86, 108.84, 17.50: none). Conditional: P = 36.28 is stated nowhere in the published corpus yet (Vision Plans docs unpublished); the KB names it by plan and tier ("the monthly premium of the unit's Vision Plans plan for the unit's coverage tier, as that plan's premium schedule states it"), so it is conditional, not RED.

**Verdict: KB-RUNTIME RED** (R0-1).
